metadata.title: OpenTUI Backspace successor with native PTY proof

work.objective: Independently fix the Bun/OpenTUI composer so Backspace deletes typed text and Tab/editing keys reach the native textarea, including option-modifier handling, with a real ready-gated Bun PTY submission proof.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for every read, search, edit and command.
Only modify the three allowlisted input-prompt files; do not modify Ink, renderer dispatch, dependencies, lockfiles, Marshal state, commit, push, publish, use network access or start subagents.
Do not import or copy files from the blocked R1 worktree; independently implement from the current branch and frozen requirements.
Do not manually slice JavaScript strings to implement deletion; route control/editing keys to TextareaRenderable native bindings.
The printable fallback must reject ctrl, meta, option, super and hyper modifiers, all C0/C1/DEL bytes, escape sequences and named editing/navigation keys while preserving ASCII, CJK and emoji input.
If an operation is denied, do not retry that path; use an allowed equivalent or report blocked.
context: The user reproduced Backspace not deleting under QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui bun packages/cli/dist/index.js.

Root cause: the global useKeyboard fallback treated Backspace sequence DEL (0x7f) as printable, inserted it and preventDefault, so the focused textarea never received its native backspace binding. Tab had the same class of risk.

R1's first review found that option was omitted from the modifier classifier. Its final attempt edited files but exhausted lifecycle budget before producing reviewable verification; R1 is BLOCKED and must not be integrated.

The native PTY gate waits for ready, types unique token ZXQ, observes it, sends DEL then Enter, and requires the subsequent user-history line to contain the submitted ZX rather than the original token.
